verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships an official CLI (installed via documented curl script) that exposes account resources as terminal commands, supports sandbox/production modes, and is explicitly positioned as the foundation for AI agent workflows (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). Independent probe evidence confirms the installer endpoint is live and serves the real installation script. Missing for 10: no independent third-party review or hands-on usage report of the CLI beyond the installer probe.
